_about: Which systems a version bump publishes. Any of "mac", "windows", "linux". Read by the tag job of .github/workflows/release.yml (a manual run's "platforms" input overrides it). A system left out keeps its current version: its installed copies are offered nothing, and the install scripts keep giving the newest release that has its files. See RELEASING.md.
_aboutMacSigning: Who signs the Mac build: "self-signed" (the "Keeper Self-Signed" certificate, KEEPER_SIGNING_CERT) or "developer-id" (Ashforde's Apple Developer ID, notarized; needs KEEPER_DEVELOPER_ID_CERT, KEEPER_DEVELOPER_ID_PASSWORD, APPLE_ID, APPLE_TEAM_ID and APPLE_APP_PASSWORD, and fails without them). Read by the tag job of .github/workflows/release.yml (a manual run's "mac_signing" input overrides it); adding a secret never changes it. Switch only after a release with the updater bridge is out: RELEASING.md → Moving to the Developer ID.
